summary: Frontend-only test of Help & Support in Partner Panel (Expo web build). App loads past onboarding, partner login via one-click demo works, /partner/support list renders with all expected testids (support-header, new-ticket, support-search, support-range, support-status, support-sort), New Ticket modal opens, category/priority chips (including 'refund' and 'urgent') render from /api/support/meta, ticket creation succeeds (TKT-100003 created and visible in list). Thread route /partner/support/{id} loads with correct testids present (ticket-thread-header, ticket-reply, send-reply, ticket-details-btn, attach-file, close-ticket) and shows the description as a GREEN own-bubble on the right with a timestamp. HOWEVER a CRITICAL interaction bug prevents the thread from being usable: the partner bottom tab bar (rendered by (partner)/_layout.tsx via <Tabs>) sits on top of the thread's bottom composer and top-right header actions, and Playwright confirmed pointer events are intercepted by tab-active. Send-reply, ticket-details-btn (opens the More drawer instead when force-clicked), attach-file and close-ticket are effectively unclickable for a real user. Reply POST /api/support/tickets/{id}/messages never fires because clicks land on the tab bar underneath. This blocks the entire chat/close/details flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Partner bottom Tabs bar overlays the ticket thread composer and header actions. Playwright reports 'div[data-testid=tab-active] ... subtree intercepts pointer events' when clicking [data-testid=send-reply]. Force-clicking bypasses to elements beneath (e.g., ticket-details-btn click actually opened the 'More' drawer 'All Menu'). Effectively makes reply, close-ticket, ticket-details-btn, and attach-file non-functional on the partner thread screen.

integration_issues.issue: POST /api/support/tickets/{id}/messages never fires because the send-reply button is covered by the partner tab bar. Body of thread still shows only the initial description bubble after send.

ticket-details-btn (i icon) in the thread header is overlapped by the bottom tab bar's 'More' hit-area only on some viewport sizes; force-click misroutes to the 'More' drawer. Detail sheet with 'Ticket ID / Department / Priority / Status / Created / Updated / Attachments / Your other tickets' could not be verified.
close-ticket button is overlapped/unreachable; native confirm and closed-state UI (composer replaced by 'This ticket is closed' and 'Ticket closed by ...' system message) could not be verified.

issues: Composer + header actions collide with the partner bottom Tabs bar. Either hide the bottom tab bar for this route (like profile/booking/[id] already do via hideTabs / href:null) or add bottom padding equal to the tab bar height and raise composer z-index above tab bar.

action_items: In app/(partner)/_layout.tsx, hide the bottom Tabs bar on support/[id] (and ideally support/index) by either adding 'support/[id]' to tabBar hideTabs behavior, or using Tabs.Screen options tabBarStyle:{display:'none'}, or wrapping the shared support screens in a Stack overlay so the composer isn't overlapped by the AppTabBar.

Alternatively, in app/support/[id].tsx add safe-area bottom padding equal to AppTabBar height and set composer container zIndex/elevation higher than tab bar, but preferred fix is to hide tab bar on the chat thread route (matches web parity where SupportCenter is not under a tab bar).
Re-test the full thread flow (send reply -> POST 200 + green bubble, details sheet content, close-ticket -> closed UI, attach-file paperclip presence).
critical_code_review_comments: app/(partner)/_layout.tsx registers partner/support/[id] as a Tabs.Screen with href:null which hides it from the tab bar but does NOT hide the tab bar when the screen is active. Need explicit tabBarStyle:{display:'none'} for the thread route, or move support thread out of the (partner) Tabs group.

The shared thread screen (frontend/app/support/[id].tsx) does not add bottom insets for a parent tab bar; this works in the (customer) app because that layout also has a tab bar of the same height but here the composer's send button is exactly under the partner 'Active Job' tab hit area causing pointer interception.

success_rate.frontend: 60% - list + create ticket work; thread interactions (reply/details/close/attach) blocked by tab bar overlap

context_for_next_testing_agent: Prev iteration_89 was CORS-blocked. That is fixed. Partner Support list + create work. The blocker now is the (partner) bottom tab bar overlapping the ticket thread screen composer/header actions - Playwright confirms tab-active intercepts pointer events on [data-testid=send-reply]. After main agent hides tab bar on partner/support/[id] (and index if desired), re-run: (1) send reply verify POST /api/support/tickets/{id}/messages and green own-bubble appears with tick, (2) ticket-details-btn opens sheet with Ticket ID/Department/Priority/Status/Created/Updated/Attachments/Your other tickets, (3) close-ticket triggers native confirm -> closed-state UI, (4) attach-file presence tap-able (picker is not automatable). Also confirm list filters (search/status/sort) and regression on partner home/jobs/wallet/profile bottom nav.
rca of the issue: app/(partner)/_layout.tsx renders <Tabs tabBar={<AppTabBar/>}> around all partner screens including the re-exported partner/support/[id]. The shared ticket thread (app/support/[id].tsx) places its message composer at the bottom of the screen with no offset for a parent tab bar. On the partner build, the AppTabBar occupies the same vertical band as the composer's [send-reply], [attach-file], and even overlaps the header's [ticket-details-btn]/[close-ticket] hit areas on 390x844. Because AppTabBar's tab items have their own touchables (data-testid=tab-active etc.), they intercept pointer events. Reproduction: login as demo partner -> go to /partner/support -> open any ticket -> attempt to click any thread control -> Playwright reports tab-active subtree intercepts pointer events. Mitigation: in (partner)/_layout.tsx pass tabBarStyle:{display:'none'} for support/[id] (and support/index if we want parity with web SupportCenter that has no bottom nav), OR wrap AppTabBar with pointerEvents='box-none' outside the visible band and ensure composer container has elevation/zIndex above tab bar plus bottom padding = tab bar height.
